name: Moss Bunny
description: A small rabbit covered in soft green moss that helps it blend into meadows. Gentle and easily spooked.

name: Spark Finch
description: A tiny bird with metallic feathers that crackle with static electricity. Curious and drawn to shiny objects.

name: Pebble Otter
description: An otter with stone-like fur patterns. Playful and loves to stack smooth river rocks.

name: Iron Tusk
description: A massive boar with tusks like forged steel. Stubborn and difficult to approach.

name: Thunder Yak
description: A proud yak with a mane that crackles with electric charge. Thunder follows where it walks.

name: Moonclaw Lynx
description: A sleek lynx with claws that shimmer like moonlight. Playful but fiercely independent.

name: Ember Wolf
description: A lean wolf with fur that glows like dying coals. Loyal to those it accepts as pack.

name: Mist Stag
description: An elegant stag whose antlers trail morning fog. Appears only in the early hours.

name: Crystal Moth
description: A delicate moth with wings like stained glass. Drawn to water's edge at twilight.

name: Quill Bear
description: A burly bear with porcupine-like spines on its back. Slow to anger, slower to forgive.

name: Cloud Jellyfish
description: A floating creature that drifts on highland winds like a living balloon. Playful and elusive.

name: Mossback Tortoise
description: An ancient tortoise with a shell carpeted in soft moss and tiny wildflowers. Moves with infinite patience.

name: Spark Tail Fox
description: A clever fox with a tail that crackles with blue electricity. Brave in the face of danger.

name: Dewdrop Squirrel
description: A small squirrel that collects morning dew in acorn cups. Playful and quick to befriend.

name: Ruin Wraith
description: A ghostly creature that haunts the crumbling ruins. Timid but drawn to those who respect the old places.

name: Geode Crab
description: A crab with a shell that looks like a split geode, crystals glinting inside. Patient and observant.
